title: Removing and re-adding a part reprices it by the work order's tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and a special-order part (Source: Vendor) not yet received on line 1, category A, cost $100.00, priced at $121.50.
  • Make sure tier A's rule in matrix A was changed to % Off 20 after the part was priced.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click the part's description to open Edit Part Request.
  3. Click Remove Part.
  4. Click Add Part under line 1.
  5. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  6. Type 1 in Qty.
  7. Pick category A in Category.
  8. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  9. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • Edit Part Request opens.

Step 3:

  • The part is gone from line 1.
  • Line 1's labor stays.

Step 4:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 5:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 6:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 7:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 8:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 9:

  • The re-added part reads $108.00 at tier A's current rule ($135.00 × 0.80 = $108.00).
